findings.description: `agent-scenarios gaps flush` has no `--config` option and ignores nightly.yaml: `_cmd_flush` resolves the spool as `args.spool or default_spool_path()` (XDG state dir) and the env names from `--url-env/--key-env` defaults, while the nightly runner derives the spool from `NightlyConfig.spool_path()` (`results.path` parent, or `gaps.spool_path`) and reads `gaps.coordinator_url_env`/`gaps.api_key_env`. The README and runbook tell operators to run a bare `agent-scenarios gaps flush`; with any non-default `results.path`, a `gaps.spool_path`, or renamed env vars, the manual flush silently reports `{"delivered": 0, "remaining": 0}` against an empty default spool while the real spool stays undelivered. Add a `--config PATH` that resolves spool and env names through `NightlyConfig`, or document that `--spool/--url-env/--key-env` must mirror the config.

`skills/tests/improve-harness/fixtures/capability-gap-entry.example.json` is a third verbatim copy of the contract example (also in the change `contracts/examples/` and in `agent_scenarios/schemas/`). `test_schemas.py` validates the package copy against the schema, but nothing asserts the skills-side copy is byte-identical to it, so a future tag or field change to the emitter's example will leave `test_scenario_parity_source.py` exercising a stale payload shape while still passing. Add an equality assertion against the package copy (resolved relative to the repo root, not a literal openspec path) or load the package copy directly.

`skills/skill-audit/scripts/evidence_join.py` still calls `build_memory_query(time_window_days=..., limit=...)` and then recalls with its own fixed `AGENT_ID = "skill-audit"`. Because the coordinator filters `agent_id` exactly (the premise of task 4.4a), scenario-parity gaps written as `agent-scenarios-nightly` are invisible to skill-audit's evidence join even though the design and memory-conventions doc present scenario-parity as a shared capability-gap source. The `build_memory_query` signature itself is unchanged, so no caller breaks; this is an unstated scope boundary. State it in design.md/runbook (improve-harness is the only consumer wired to the nightly writer) or extend evidence_join to the multi-agent query.

Module docstring of `test_memory_tag_conventions.py` still says `source:` works "for all four vocabulary values" while `SOURCE_VOCABULARY` in the same file now lists five (scenario-parity added). Also `gh_shim` `pr list` without `--json` prints JSON rather than real gh's table, a minor fidelity divergence worth noting in the shim docstring.
findings.existing_code: - source: tag prefix works for all four vocabulary values

findings.description: `_post_memory_query` catches `URLError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError` but `resp.read().decode()` can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` (a `ValueError`, not caught) on a non-UTF-8 body from a proxy or error page, which would propagate out of `query_memory` and abort `analyze_failures.py`, `generate_report.py` and `export_shared_learnings.py` instead of degrading to the documented warning-and-empty-result behaviour. Catch `ValueError` (which also covers JSONDecodeError) in that handler.

In `docs/guides/memory-conventions.md` the new scenario-parity bias bullet is separated from the preceding bullet list by a blank line, so it renders as a separate one-item list rather than continuing the list. Remove the blank line.
